7: Linux local Docker cgroup v2 + builtin seccomp enforced; immutable preinstalled image ID only; no automatic service installation/start/image pull or weak fallback.
Read-only input staging with no-follow descriptors; reject FIFO/symlinks/directory replacement, bounded input count/bytes, no writable host mount.
Network none, no capabilities/new privileges, nonroot, readonly rootfs, bounded memory/no swap, CPU, PIDs, work/tmp tmpfs, file/aggregate output and stdout/stderr.

Quiesced in-container collector obtains tmpfs artifacts; host validates regular-file archive. Whole-container force removal and verified cleanup on normal completion, failure, timeout and explicit cancellation.
Notebook UI labels the actual mode; blocked unsupported-host records and downloadable isolation/image/seed/environment/input-output identities; QDK host-interpreter intake explicitly rejected.
Actual standalone CLI and existing pipeline CLI exercised in real Linux containers; strict pipeline config validator and JSON schema accept only enforced policy.
8: 13 versioned synthetic financial-research evidence cases, 18 required claims, separately authored literal annotations with scalar/Decimal rationales.
Explicit public packet excludes answers/rationales; deterministic evidence reasoner accepts public data only, no case-ID answer lookup.
Structured scoring checks financial arithmetic, costs/cashflows, evidence pointers, decision, missing failures, conflicts, comparable basis, timing, sufficiency, multiple testing and abstention.
JSON/HTML reports retain exact public/label/submission/scorer identities and per-case rationales/errors; missing cases remain in denominator, extra unsupported claims fail.
Actual offline baseline 13/13 cases and 18/18 claims; evaluator correctly accepts one positive and rejects ten independent error controls. Online model quality is explicitly not measured.

local_tests.notes: Includes actual local Notebook success/error/environment drift/cancellation and JupyterLab save/submit/plot/download. 26 optional platform/upstream tests explicitly skipped; actual Docker runs are separate Linux CI. Final later changes are backend pin metadata and CI evidence upload only.
Separate lock-consistent environment; Windows skips Linux descriptor/Docker tests. Exact candidate Linux CI supplies real backend verification.

independent_controls: Actual Linux attacks: unmapped host sentinel, readonly inputs/rootfs, external TCP/DNS rejection, cgroup limits, memory exhaustion, PID limit, deliberately unclean hostile PID saturation, tmpfs/per-file/aggregate output bounds, symlink output, log flood, timeout and cancellation with live descendants.
Docker HOME/config proxy credential sentinel absent from payload; fresh empty client config, no inherited host API sentinel.
FIFO and directory-swap negative cases are real Linux filesystem operations, not mocks.

Numeric annotations independently recomputed with Decimal; wrong conclusion with correct evidence, incorrect net return, naive cashflow return, omitted failures, conflict denial, wrong evidence, missing abstention and caveat gaming are rejected.

Coordinator independently perturbed IDs and unseen ledger numbers (200/20/25); baseline returned -5 / -0.025 and independent negative submissions failed. Coordinator evidence lives in its review directory, not edited here.

environment.dependency_note: Pipeline and agent locks pin incompatible pandas/pyarrow versions; final local tests use separate environments. After two GitHub partial-clone TLS failures, quant-workspace v0.3.1 was fetched without partial clone at 537388a4d9548b612fa1e4b306c482c04b45c433 and built into wheels/quant_workspace-0.3.1-py3-none-any.whl. pipeline-local-validation.lock changes only that transport to the verified same-source local wheel; repository lock files unchanged.

review_repairs: Empty Docker client configuration + proxy sentinel
Nonblocking descriptor staging rejects FIFOs and symlink replacement
Trusted quiesced collector replaces Docker copy API for tmpfs
Hostile PID saturation fails honestly and cleans all descendants
Narrow hidden-file upload retains actual Notebook run/isolation/environment/log records
Strict YAML/JSON policy declaration and both actual product CLI paths
limits: Linux Docker local daemon/cgroup v2 only; Windows refuses actual isolation, and interactive JupyterLab is trusted-local.
Daemon/kernel/image/operator trusted; no claim against their compromise. Host crash or SIGKILL can prevent cleanup and requires operator inspection of labeled containers.
Finite Notebook mode rejects host-only QDK intake interpreters; typed v2 pipeline DAG isolation is not included.
Benchmark is a public synthetic regression specification, not an external human audit, unseen model holdout, arbitrary prose grading, online LLM quality result or real-market certification.
No live orders, production deployment, paid model/data calls, account recovery, default-branch merges or changes to F:/Quant/older scratch workspaces.
